question: Should Discord Activities be supported by adding an Activity-specific Gateway/A2UI access path, and if so what credential boundary should that path require?
rationale: The PR intentionally creates a public Discord Activity access route into A2UI, so maintainers need to choose the product and security model before automation can safely repair the implementation.

options.title: Require plugin-owned fail-closed Activity auth
options.body: Port the work into the Canvas/Discord plugin contracts and require a non-URL, mandatory credential or signed launch context before bypassing normal Gateway/node auth.

options.title: Keep as an explicit prototype
options.body: Leave this draft open only as design exploration while a separate reviewed branch owns the current plugin-path implementation.

options.title: Close in favor of a narrower replacement
options.body: Ask for a fresh PR that implements only the launch action and auth bridge in current plugin paths with focused live Discord proof.

recommendation.title: Require plugin-owned fail-closed Activity auth
recommendation.body: Port the work into the Canvas/Discord plugin contracts and require a non-URL, mandatory credential or signed launch context before bypassing normal Gateway/node auth.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest Discord feature-history signal and authored the Activity branch.
